sql.ricochetWebhook.getContactIdByLeadId: select contact_id from flow.contact_custom_field_value where text_value = :ricochetLeadId
sql.ricochetWebhook.insertLead: with state as ( select (case when :stateAbbreviation is not null then s.id else null::integer end) id from flow.state s where s.abbreviation = :stateAbbreviation ), company_country as ( select cc.id id from flow.company_country cc where cc.company_id = 3 ), owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id, (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.id else 9016 --Sales Dev Lead's user position ID end) user_position_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) insert into flow.contact (contact_type_id, first_name, last_name, mobile, email, street1, city, postal_code, state_id, created_by_id, company_id, owner_user_position_id, company_country_id) (select 2, :firstName, :lastName, :mobile, :email, :street1, :city, :postalCode, (select id from state), (select user_id from owner), 3, (select user_position_id from owner), (select company_country.id from company_country)) returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.updateLead: with state as ( select (case when :stateAbbreviation is not null then s.id else null::integer end) id from flow.state s where s.abbreviation = :stateAbbreviation ), company_country as ( select cc.id id from flow.company_country cc where cc.company_id = 3 ), owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id, (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.id else 9016 --Sales Dev Lead's user position ID end) user_position_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) update flow.contact set first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, mobile = :mobile, email = :email, street1 = :street1, city = :city, postal_code = :postalCode, state_id = (select id from state), created_by_id = (select user_id from owner), owner_user_position_id = (select user_position_id from owner), company_country_id = (select company_country.id from company_country) where id = :contactId returning id
sql.ricochetWebhook.checkIfCustomFieldDropdo: select id from flow.list_of_value where parent_id = :listOfValueId and name = :customFieldDropdownValue
sql.ricochetWebhook.insertCustomFieldDropdow: with display_order as ( select max(display_order) as value from flow.list_of_value where parent_id = :listOfValueId ), owner as ( select (case when :leadOwnerEmail is not null then up.user_id else 2371412 --Sales Dev Lead's user ID end) user_id from flow.user_position up inner join flow.user u on u.id = up.user_id where u.email = :leadOwnerEmail and up.primary_flag is true ) insert into flow.list_of_value (name, parent_id, display_order, created_by_id) (select :customFieldDropdownValue, :listOfValueId, ((select value from display_order) + 1), (select user_id from owner)) returning id
